emailBackgrounds: removed at sanitize and Outlook document render time
savedTemplates: existing browser-saved templates are cleaned during rendering
emailFontColor: automatic; outgoing inline font colors are removed at render time
transitionDateScope: yesterday, today, or both; today is the default
transitionMessageGrouping: selected notes sharing a normalized driver code, driver name, or truck number are rendered in one chronological card
groupingCounts: selected note counts remain raw-note counts; group_count reports matched cards
